fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, knocks targets back 2 tiles and makes them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Notice
fusions.desc: Fires a warning shot that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring resistances. It has a 60% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Marked for Mercy
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Remembered Stench
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by something other than fire, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 15 seconds.
